data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Clea was a goddess of fertility and the harvest. The name Clea comes from the Greek word kleos, meaning 'glory, fame'. In Christian tradition, Clea is believed to be a derivative of the name Clara, meaning 'bright, clear, and famous'. The name Clea carries the meaning “Glory, fame” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Clea usually hope their child will grow to embody glory, fame and live with faith, good character and purpose.
